entities.description: A close-up, out-of-focus view of a white, glossy ceramic object, likely a vase, occupying the left foreground with a smooth, curved surface and a bright specular highlight. The background is heavily blurred, showing a light beige wall and the corner of a light wooden frame or shelf structure.

attributes.background: blurred beige wall and wooden frame

entities.description: A person wearing a white long-sleeved shirt is writing in an open notebook with a blue pen on a white marble desk. The notebook has a dark blue cover and a visible orange ribbon bookmark, and the person's hands are positioned over the pages, with one hand holding the pen and the other resting on the page.

A glossy blue ballpoint pen is held in a person's right hand, positioned diagonally with the tip pointing down towards a white surface. The pen features a metallic silver clip and a silver conical tip, with a visible seam separating the cap from the barrel.

A young woman with brown hair tied in a high bun and wearing black-rimmed glasses is seated at a table, smiling gently while writing in an open notebook with a blue pen. She is wearing a plain white long-sleeved sweatshirt.

A wooden tripod floor lamp with three slender, light-brown legs converging at a central hub, supporting a white lampshade at the top, positioned in the background behind a person wearing a white long-sleeved shirt.
